corpus.animationSources: Retained cartoon and Fossils excerpts, 96 frames each. Browser trials request four seconds, at 2x. Encoding comparisons use 360p; decoding and animation playback comparisons use 1080p.
corpus.flatHold: Synthetic 1080p60 three-second uniform hold with a 440 Hz tone, only a regression workload, not evidence for general video encoding performance.

detailPrefix.recipe: Copy the first 106 synchronized visual/audio chunks from every rendition, without refitting or recompressing payloads. Retain their durations and checksums, rewrite absolute offsets, and update chunks, frame/source counts, duration, average FPS and per-quality byte counts. Prefix coverage ends at the first shared boundary at or after ten seconds.
detailPrefix.claimLimit: Ten seconds of this source do not establish full two-minute playback or broader live-action coverage.

constrainedLinkCorrectness.conditions: Unit, native and end-to-end correctness jobs ran concurrently. These timings are diagnostics, not a controlled speed comparison.

forced100msCheckpoints.reason: Archive growth was excessive and repacking the 1080p cartoon exceeded a 16 MiB shared chunk. Production retains size-oriented packet selection.
forced100msCheckpoints.provenanceLimit: Temporary experimental binary hash was not captured; its timings are diagnostic only.

simdPrototype.reason: Intermediate decoder showed only a small completed-pixel improvement, insufficient here to justify a second decoder bundle. The shipped decoder remains portable.
simdPrototype.provenanceLimit: Intermediate-revision microbenchmark, not a comparison against the final decoder or a sustained-playback result.

initialLeadDeadlock.reason: Waiting for lead while future results occupied all capacity could stall preparation. Final readiness stops waiting at the image/event limit, and reservations protect the next contiguous event without double-reserving an in-flight image. Regression tests cover both cases.

planePrediction.scope: Lossless plane prediction. SCI versions, fitted ASCII attributes, audio, seek boundaries, quality, and delivery budgets are unchanged.

conditions.medianConvention: Upper middle order statistic, matching the benchmark runners.

encoding.interpretation: No meaningful end-to-end encoding improvement measured. Both complete output byte counts and every reconstructed pixel and presentation timestamp match. The encoder runner validates audio but does not compare its encoded hash.

cartoonCombinedTenPasses.reason: First five-pass batch showed a 5.84 percent p95 regression. A second full five-pass batch checked that concern; both batches are retained and combined, without discarding runs.

decoding.detailScope: First 60 presentation events of the retained 1080p60 prefix. Direct WASM output, excluding network, worker initialization, canvas presentation and audio scheduling. Exact complete pixel hashes match. The third result in the final detail comparison is the threshold-only ablation; the first two are baseline and final candidate.
decoding.thresholdAblationScope: The initial paeth-comparison used the baseline and threshold-only WASM, including cell output. Its player/web/decoder.wasm path names the intermediate threshold-only build, not the final candidate. Final direct RGBA measurements are in detailFirst60Events.

constrainedLinkCorrectnessDiagnostic.scope: Correctness diagnostics, run alongside other correctness checks. Not a controlled speed comparison. A passing ingestion test does not establish uninterrupted playback.

vectorGlyphInitialization.implementation: AVX2 evaluates eight fixed glyph masks per batch. Exact 16-bit reciprocal means, squared errors and stable tie handling preserve glyphs, reflections and RGB attributes. Runtime feature detection guards the AVX2 function; the existing scalar path remains on other targets and CPUs.

conditions.otherApplications: Existing user applications remained running; CPU frequency was not pinned.
conditions.concurrency: One measured benchmark at a time; no concurrent owned tests, compiles, conversions or rendering jobs.
conditions.verification: Every expanded ASCII cell, reconstructed pixel and presentation time matches. Complete SCI byte counts match. Audio is validated, but encoded audio hashes are not compared.
conditions.scope: Cartoon and fossils contain 96 events each, over 4.004 and four seconds. Weave contains 240 events over four seconds at 60 FPS. These are full local 360p encodes, not real-time ingestion or sustained playback.

limitations: Observed median gains are small, 1.10 through 3.40 percent on these inputs.
The remaining greedy layer search, entropy coding and browser decoder are unchanged.
No file-size reduction, H.266 advantage or zero-buffering claim.
No timing result covers other CPU architectures or default unpinned ingestion.
